    // The half-open window [from, exclusiveTo), holding exclusiveTo - from
    // elements. Matches `ISliceable.Slice` exactly, so `Slice` means the same
    // thing on every receiver in the tree (plato-378).
    // Precondition: 0 <= from <= exclusiveTo <= Count.
    Slice(xs: Array<$T>, from: Integer, exclusiveTo: Integer): Array<$T>
        => MapRange(exclusiveTo - from, i => xs[from + i]);
